mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule_polls (calendar_id, title, description, location, status, confirmed_schedule_id, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{calendarId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{location}, 'open', NULL, #{createdBy}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, calendar_id, title, description, location, status, confirmed_schedule_id, created_by, created_at FROM schedule_polls WHERE calendar_id = #{calendarId} ORDER BY (status = 'open') DESC, created_at DESC
